mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, username, nickname, role, enabled, token_version, created_at FROM sys_user
(username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND enabled = #{enabled}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN role = 'ADMIN' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user(username, password_hash, nickname, role, enabled, token_version) VALUES(#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{role}, #{enabled}, #{tokenVersion})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_user SET role = CASE WHEN username = #{adminUsername} THEN 'ADMIN' ELSE 'USER' END
